notes: The kept set covers LINE-1 structure, retrotransposition and regulatory roles; ERV/TE-derived enhancers and genes (placenta, 3D genome, cancer, ZGA, domesticated PEG10); TE-derived tumour antigens and TE-driven inflammation and neurodegeneration; host silencing (piRNA, AGO2, HUSH, KRAB-ZFPs, PRC2, m6A/DNA methylation); TE exonization; plant and fungal TE evolution and pangenome variation; prokaryotic transposons (TnpB, IS110 bridge RNAs, CRISPR-Tn7) plus a few plasmid/MGE studies at the end. It lacks Alu/SINE-specific work, horizontal transfer of TEs between animals, somatic retrotransposition in human tumour genomes, and TE dynamics in non-model animals beyond Drosophila; the shortlist itself was diluted by about half with genome-resource and pathogen-epidemiology papers that only mention mobile elements.
